fields.Name: T223 - Grid Export to Excel
fields.Description: Triggers a grid's Export to Excel and verifies the export initiates without error.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Products' entity grid — type 'Products' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click it (or navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Products). Wait for the grid to load. In the grid toolbar (controls above the grid, mostly upper-right): click the 'Export to Excel' control (Excel-file icon) — or the 'Export' button and choose Excel. Verify the export INITIATES cleanly: a download begins, or an export options dialog / a success toast/notification appears — and there is NO error. (You do NOT need to open the downloaded file; a clean export trigger is success.) Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The grid's 'Export to Excel' (or Export→Excel) control was clicked
The export initiated cleanly (a download started, or an export dialog / success toast appeared) with no error
No error messages or crash pages
